title: Reject v0.11 implementation under broken frozen ownership closure and open governed v0.11.1 retry
context: REL-0.11-FROZEN-001 became unsatisfiable before implementation because its exact successor universe omitted 52 freeze-time shipped paths and could not legally admit later implementation/evidence paths.
decision: Preserve all v0.11 frozen and blocker evidence unchanged.
Keep v0.10 as executable promoted authority.
Open v0.11.1 as a separately preregistered retry with unchanged structural product targets and stricter immutable-boundary mechanics.
Require REG-0025 prospective path closure before v0.11.1 may freeze.
non_decisions: No v0.11 frozen target is rewritten.
No v0.11 implementation result is claimed.
No ESIS/top-5 forward-direction feature is pulled into retry promotion metrics.
supersedes_for_active_development: REL-0.11-FROZEN-001 implementation authorization only; historical contract remains immutable evidence.
